title: A deadline calendar for filings and renewals

sections.skill: Build one calendar for filings, renewals and payments

questions.prompt: Which is a recurring business deadline?
questions.intro: Businesses have recurring deadlines: state annual reports, license and permit renewals, sales tax filings, estimated tax payments, insurance renewals, domain renewals, and registered agent fees. Missing one can bring late fees, penalties, or even a business being marked inactive by the state. Keep one DEADLINE CALENDAR with each item, its due date, how often it repeats, where to file, and a reminder set early enough to gather what you need, such as two weeks before.

sections.skill: A family calendar on the fridge

questions.prompt: A fridge calendar is like what?
questions.intro: Families often keep one calendar on the fridge: doctor visits, school events, bills. If every person kept their own scraps of paper, things would be missed. A business deadline calendar works the same way: one place, every important date, with a note written a couple of weeks before so nothing sneaks up. Everyone in the business can look in the same place.
